model.name: canonical EDSR-L
model.deployment: pure physical 24-block EDSR state_dict; no Teacher, Router, Mask, map, scheduler, hook, or runtime attachment

data.pairing: normalize an x{scale} suffix before matching stems; require unique exact stem sets and readable RGB images; recovery pairs require exact HR=scale*LR, while evaluation permits only standard top-left modcrop of fewer than scale trailing HR rows/columns to match LR
data.inventory: ordered relative paths and byte sizes are hashed for every recovery split

training.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR over exactly 500 optimizer updates, eta_min=0
training.teacher_mode: eval, requires_grad=False, output produced under no_grad
training.checkpoint_policy: final step only; never select best validation or benchmark checkpoint
training.continuation: Random-sample loss windows are descriptive only. Continue unless a fatal criterion occurs.
fatal_criteria: data pairing, split, readability, or geometry failure
static Student audit or strict final round-trip failure

evaluation.input: full image, batch 1, FP32 eager PyTorch; HR is standard top-left modcropped by at most scale-1 trailing rows/columns to exactly match LR geometry
evaluation.psnr: per-image PSNR-Y with data range 255, then arithmetic mean
evaluation.ssim: per-image SSIM-Y using 11x11 Gaussian window sigma 1.5 and K1=0.01/K2=0.03, then arithmetic mean
evaluation.confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval across seeds; t(2)=4.3026527299 for n=3
evaluation.selection: none; all final-step seeds are reported
evaluation.latency_boundary: RTX 4090 training throughput is descriptive only; final deployment p50/p95 must later be rerun on the common RTX 4060 stack

cloud.release_policy: persist status and verified success/failure bundle first; request release immediately with bounded retries; shutdown fallback is explicitly not billing-safe

artifact_policy.resume: atomic rolling state includes Student, optimizer, scheduler, completed step, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG, and frozen run-config hash
artifact_policy.final_checkpoint: pure Student state_dict with strict finite-forward verification and SHA-256
artifact_policy.bundle: explicit goal-owned file list, internal per-file SHA-256 manifest, verified tar member hashes, sibling archive SHA-256
